title: Blocked sender
description: One decision to block a sender of unwanted email: an address or a whole domain, the node of the decision tree that classified it, and why. One record per value. The data lives in a source of record that the project names, never in this repository.

value.description: The full email address or the domain that is blocked, always in lowercase. It is stored with [.] in place of each dot and [@] in place of each at sign, so no tool turns it into a link, and the lists to paste restore them.

kind.description: What the value is. An address blocks one sender. A domain blocks every address on it.

block_chrome_url.description: Whether the domain also goes in the browser block list of URLs. It is a choice, never a checkbox: yes and no are decisions of the person, and maybe is a decision that still waits for an answer. Always no for an address.

node.description: The node of the decision tree that classified the value.

reason.description: Why the value was blocked, in one sentence.

display_name.description: The name the sender showed in the message.

decided_by.description: The person who decided, always asked for and never assumed.

decided_at.description: The date of the decision, as an object with start.
